_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Cost Breakdown Structure Summary Report
summary: The Cost Breakdown Structure Summary Report provides the project cost allocation by cost category and applicable fiscal appropriation determined by the contractor to deliver and support a system during contract performance.
use_relationship:
The Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) Summary Report provides the project cost allocation by cost category and applicable fiscal appropriate determined by the contractor to deliver and support a system during the performance of a contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for each tech data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to all cost reimbursable type contracts over $100,000 in value and 6 months duration, involving development of hardware or software.

It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein shall be applied to every program or program phase. Portions of this DID are subject to deletion tailoring depending upon the program phases in which it is applied in the contract.

This DID is related to DI-FNCL-80166B, Cost Breakdown Structure Detailed Report.

This DID supersede DI-FNCL-80165.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation; for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Cost Breakdown Structure Summary Report shall be prepared using the DD Form 2417, See Figure 1.

children.title: System/Project Identification.
children.content: Identification of the system or project.

children.title: Columns (a) through (d)
children.content: enter the dollars for each Acquisition Cost Category by applicable appropriation.

children.title: Columns (e)
children.content: enter the total program cost for each Acquisition Cost Category.

children.title: Section B, System Acquisition Cost Tools.
Columns (a) through (e)
children.content: enter the sum totals for each column for Section A.

children.title: Section C, Life Cycle Support Cost Categories.
Columns (a) through (d)
children.content: enter the dollars Life Cycle Support (LCS) cost category by applicable appropriation.

children.title: Section D, Life Cycle Support Cost Totals.
Columns (a) through (e)
children.content: enter the sum totals for each column of Section C.
